servers.name: local-effort-mcp
servers.description: Streamable HTTP MCP server for Local Effort Food Co. exposing support search and Sanity read-only access.

tools.name: support.search
tools.description: Hybrid semantic + keyword search over Supabase support chunks.

tools.name: sanity.query
tools.description: Execute read-only GROQ queries against the Sanity dataset.

notes: Initialize via POST /.well-known/mcp with JSON-RPC 2.0 payloads and keep a GET connection open for streaming responses.
Echo the Mcp-Session-Id header value returned by the server on subsequent requests to resume the session.
Optional allowlists can be configured via MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS and MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS environment variables.
